integrity: The integral torus calculation follows from the connected free double-cover graph lemma; finite enumeration independently verifies incidence and selected base-field counts, not the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic at least five; finite-field classification of the reduced forty-eight-line curve only. No assertion about ambient K3 surface point counts, small-characteristic exceptional lines or Picard component groups. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: The genus-289 Fermat quartic line divisor: integral torus and point-free arithmetic
